pip_update_template: 1. Executive read: are we moving toward 4x ROAS or not?
2. Primary bottleneck: show rate / lead quality / booking quality / close rate / cash ROAS.
3. Live webinar stats: spend, CPL, booked calls, show rate, close rate, cash collected when available.
4. Evergreen webinar stats: spend, registrants/leads, booked calls, show rate when available.
5. DM funnel stats: conversations, calendar sent rate, booked calls, close rate, cash collected when available.
6. Sydney/Bu1 read: key KPIs + creative move today.
7. Nate/Bu2 read: key KPIs + creative move today.
8. Creative system: target, shipped, blocked, next asks.
9. Google Ads / form qualifier / attribution status.
10. Decisions/blockers needing Richard or team input.

formal_pip_doc.title: Paid Media | Tactical Action Plan & Performance Improvement Plan

items: Audit BU1 and BU2 pixels separately on all landing + webinar opt-in pages
Verify Page View, Lead, Complete Registration fire correctly with no double-fires in GA4/GHL
Document Events Manager / Pixel Helper proof screenshots
Confirm BU1 and BU2 Meta UTMs pass into GHL CRM
Document cold-audience rebuild/optimization needs for BU1 and BU2 separately
Exclude retargeting pools where needed and use clean conversion data for lookalikes
Pause ad sets above acceptable CPL threshold
Swap creatives on ad sets running 7+ days without improvement
Test at least two new creative angles this week for each BU
Audit ad copy/creative for false-promise signals and message mismatch
Tighten audience targeting when cheap leads produce weak show rate
Review time-of-day delivery / dayparting
Confirm optimization event is Complete Registration or best event tag, not just Lead
Confirm GHL reminder sequences fire correctly and pull show rate segmented by traffic source
Build separate Search + Remarketing campaigns for BU1 and BU2
Write 3–5 RSAs per BU, aligned with offer/brand voice
Set conversion tracking to webinar registration / appointments after pixel verification
Verify landing-page UTMs pass into GHL
Launch conservative test budgets; scale only after 48 hours of conversion data
Add launch negative keywords: free, jobs, careers, DIY, template, tutorial, etc.
Build remarketing for visitors who did not register
Mobile page load under 3 seconds
Opt-in form submits correctly and triggers correct GHL workflow
Thank-you page / confirmation next-step CTA works
UTM source/medium/campaign/content appear on GHL contact record
Mobile QA on iOS and Android
Complete Registration fires on submit with screenshot proof
Daily Slack check-in by 5:00 PM ET: completed, in progress, blockers
EOW report due Friday 5/23 by 5:00 PM ET covering BU1 and BU2 separately
EOW must include ROAS, CPL, webinar show rate, call book rate, pixel screenshots, Google Ads live screenshots, top 3 wins, top 3 blockers/issues, next-week priority adjustments
